items.title: Dawoud Sabu Adeyola interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, January 30, 2025
items.q: The drummer is Louie Marino and the bass player is Sabu Adeyola.

ctx.x: And he described how you guys worked together and he said, and then his quote was: “Well it didn’t take us long to do this because I have two exceptionally fine musicians. The drummer is Louie Marino and the bass player is Sabu Adeyola. He’s wanted all over town by the right people.”

He’s so kind. He’s my second father you know. Yeah you know what? He actually told my father that. He says, ‘cause both of my parents were alive at the time. And sometimes I’d take him by the house you know, because they loved him too. Actually Fanny’s was right around the corner from where my parents used to live you know. And so one time we’re sitting there at the kitchen table having coffee and he tells my dad, he says, “Oh by the way I’ve adopted your son, is that all right? Is that okay with you?” He said,…
